name: Holiday Classic Deviled Eggs (Mayo & Yellow Mustard — No Relish/Cayenne)
whyItWorks: Hard-boiled egg whites and mashed yolks whipped with a touch of mayo and yellow mustard provide 6g of pure, zero-fiber, dairy-free protein per two halves.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Choose classic deviled eggs made without crunchy pickle relish, bacon bits, or spicy cayenne pepper (a light dusting of mild sweet paprika is fine).
watchOuts: Avoid deviled eggs topped with pickled jalapeño slices, cayenne pepper, or chunky dill pickle relish
